svg.title: Metro Station — SwiftUI design system visual reference
svg.desc: Editable static vector atlas of canonical colors, content, metal and native glass material families, independent drawing and readout layers, and compact interaction contracts. Every glass illustration is schematic rather than a native Liquid Glass rendering.

g.text: SwiftUI design system · A calibrated visual vocabulary for native instruments

svg.text: RGB doubles are canonical. Hex approximates 8-bit sRGB; material pixels depend on the OS and backdrop.

g.text: Readout and controls receive no sensor transform.
Glass is a separate native sibling
Frame first; native clear material; centered radius.
Clear face with faint edge-only reflection.
Static schematic layers. The native glass appearance must be checked in the destination app.
A control owns its complete touch.
Keep pill borders and labels constant.

svg.text: CURRENT: Metro Station build 14. Recommended adoption improvements are identified in the specification.
STATIC VECTOR ATLAS · Glass is schematic · No native runtime or physical-feedback proof
